colourSpace: linear RGB values as serialized by URP materials and lights
purpose: Locked material and lighting direction for the North-West Power Regulation Chamber. This is authoring data, not a material asset; corebuster_env_036 creates the room-owned URP/Lit materials from these values.

calibration.note: The Workshop remaps scalar kit metallic into 0.1-0.4 so its lit copies retain diffuse response in a dark enclosed room.

materials.note: Texture-backed bare-steel finish; its Workshop use supplies the worn metal intent, but its metallic value is deliberately not copied to Room 3.

limits.largeSurfaceDefinition: Any continuous painted or metal field of at least 0.5 square metres, or a material covering more than 10 percent of a machine assembly's visible area.
limits.darkDetailException: Grime, seams, bolts, cable interiors and narrow recesses may fall below the luminance limit, but cannot form a large surface or the base of an assembly.

swatches.usage: Default dominant cabinet, turbine and wall-service plating; vary only with restrained grime and edge wear.
Secondary panels, plinths and larger insulated housings; keep it subordinate to warm grey.
Rails, ribs, mounts, frames and compact recesses only; never use as the dominant body finish.
Pipes, valves, service couplings and transformer oil tanks; use as a legible industrial rhythm, not a room-wide wash.
Machine bands, panel borders and secondary identification paint.
Small warning bands, conduit markings and aisle-edge details; never cover an entire machine body.
Mask, decal or compact overlay only: chips, leak paths and soot around joints. It must reveal the warm-grey, tan, oxide or ochre substrate.
Primary practical light and matching fixture glow. Each bay and open-space entrance needs a visible fixture; containment and the four-additional-light cap still win.
Room 3-only warning accent, increasingly frequent toward Boss Hall Door; use for beacons, small labels and emergency indicators, never as the base palette.
Restrained power-equipment accent: transformer arcs, indicator lenses and local status strips only. It must not compete with the reactor or primary amber lighting.

ownership.rule: corebuster_env_036 creates flattened Room 3 URP/Lit copies under Assets/FPS/Art/NorthWestRoom/Rendering/Materials, keyed by the source material GUID. It assigns them only to Room 3 renderers and restores any accidental external reference.
ownership.weathering: Use Room 3-owned base materials plus Room 3-owned mask/decal/overlay assets. Do not reference Assets/FPS/Art/Materials/Workshop/, Centre Room copies, or a Workshop material directly.
ownership.sharedAssets: Third-party prefabs and materials remain unchanged. Reused prefabs receive only per-instance Room 3 material overrides.
